<p>For questions, please contact <a href="mailto:CINEA-CEF-TRANSPORT-CALLS@ec.europa.eu"><i>CINEA-CEF-TRANSPORT-CALLS@ec.europa.eu</i></a></p>
<p> </p>
<p>15/12/2022 11:13</p>
<p>There are few days left to finish your application in response to any of the 9 CEF Transport calls for proposals, closing on 18 January 2023 at 17:00. In total, 41 topics are open for submission on the  <a href="https://ec.europa.eu/info/funding-tenders/opportunities/portal/screen/opportunities/topic-search;callCode=null;freeTextSearchKeyword=CEF-T-2022;matchWholeText=true;typeCodes=1,0;statusCodes=31094502,31094503,31094501;programmePeriod=2021%20-%202027;programCcm2Id=43251567;programDivisionCode=null;focusAreaCode=null;destinationGroup=null;missionGroup=null;geographicalZonesCode=null;programmeDivisionProspect=null;startDateLte=null;startDateGte=null;crossCuttingPriorityCode=null;cpvCode=null;performanceOfDelivery=null;sortQuery=sortStatus;orderBy=asc;onlyTenders=false;topicListKey=topicSearchTablePageState">Funding & Tenders portal</a>.</p>
<p>We strongly advise you not to wait until the last minute to submit your application!</p>
<p>You may also see <a href="https://cinea.ec.europa.eu/funding-opportunities/calls-proposals/2022-cef-transport-call_en">the Call</a> page, and the <a href="https://cinea.ec.europa.eu/news-events/events/2022-cef-transport-call-info-day-2022-10-05_en">Info Day page</a> to find the presentations and recording of the info day session. More than 600 FAQs are now available on the <a href="https://ec.europa.eu/info/funding-tenders/opportunities/portal/screen/support/faq;type=0,1;categories=;tenders=;programme=43251567;keyword=;freeTextSearchKeyword=CEF%20Transport;matchWholeText=true;period=null;status=0;sortQuery=relevance;faqListKey=faqSearchTablePageState">FAQ support</a> on the Funding & Tenders portal.</p>
<p>To be admissible your application must contain Part A and the GIS duly completed online, and Part B uploaded on time. As indicated in section 5 of the Call document – also available on the <a href="https://ec.europa.eu/info/funding-tenders/opportunities/portal/screen/how-to-participate/reference-documents">Reference Documents</a> of the portal, <b>the mandatory annexes must also be submitted</b>. These documents concern:</p>
<p>-          Agreement by the concerned Member States benefitting from the project  – for all applications</p>
<p>-          Calculator for ERTMS and RFN applications or detailed budget table per Work Package for other applications</p>
<p>-          Timetable/Gantt chart – for all applications</p>
<p>-          Environmental compliance file including the required declarations for all applications (except ERTMS and RFN applications). Please see the <a href="https://ec.europa.eu/info/funding-tenders/opportunities/portal/screen/support/faq/18080">FAQ 18080</a>. </p>
<p>-          Activity reports of last year and List of previous projects - unless exempted from operational capacity check such as public bodies, member state organisations, international organisations and beneficiaries of grants under CEF1 and CEF2.    </p>
<p>In addition, if the application concerns works: </p>
<p>-          Full cost-benefit analysis (CBA) report and CBA cash flow template - only for works or mixed projects with a budget (eligible costs) above EUR 10 million - <a href="https://ec.europa.eu/info/funding-tenders/opportunities/portal/screen/support/faq/17952">unless exempted</a></p>
<p>-          Simplified CBA calculator – only for works or mixed projects with a budget (eligible costs) below EUR 10 million - <a href="https://ec.europa.eu/info/funding-tenders/opportunities/portal/screen/support/faq/17952">unless exempted</a></p>

<p>To be admissible your application must contain Part A and the GIS duly completed online, and Part B uploaded on time. These documents concern:</p>
<p>-          Agreement by the concerned Member States benefitting from the project  – for all applications</p>
<p>-          Calculator for ERTMS and RFN applications or detailed budget table per Work Package for other applications</p>
<p>-          Timetable/Gantt chart – for all applications</p>
<p>-          Environmental compliance file including the required declarations for all applications (except ERTMS and RFN applications). Please see the <a href="https://ec.europa.eu/info/funding-tenders/opportunities/portal/screen/support/faq/18080">FAQ 18080</a>. </p>
<p>-          Activity reports of last year and List of previous projects - unless exempted from operational capacity check such as public bodies, member state organisations, international organisations and beneficiaries of grants under CEF1 and CEF2.    </p>
<p>In addition, if the application concerns works: </p>
<p>-          Full cost-benefit analysis (CBA) report and CBA cash flow template - only for works or mixed projects with a budget (eligible costs) above EUR 10 million - <a href="https://ec.europa.eu/info/funding-tenders/opportunities/portal/screen/support/faq/17952">unless exempted</a></p>
<p>-          Simplified CBA calculator – only for works or mixed projects with a budget (eligible costs) below EUR 10 million - <a href="https://ec.europa.eu/info/funding-tenders/opportunities/portal/screen/support/faq/17952">unless exempted</a></p>

title: Adapting the transport infrastructure for Union external border checks purposes - studies, works or mixed
callTitle: CEF 2 Transport - Actions related to safe and secure mobility - Cohesion envelope
descriptionByte:
Objective:

The general objective is to modernise transport infrastructure on the Core and Comprehensive Networks of the TEN-T.

Scope:

In accordance with Article 9(2)(b)(x) of the CEF Regulation, the following projects will be supported:

  • studies and / or works aiming at facilitating traffic flows for all land and waterborne transport modes at border controls areas at the Union external border of the TEN-T network in accordance with Article 9(2)(b)(x) of the CEF Regulation. The supported projects, targeting only the transport infrastructure, will inter alia improve the connections to the border crossing points, and parking lines and spaces related to the border control. Where relevant, coordination with relevant Interreg IPA-CBC programmes should be ensured by the applicants.

<p><b>Information update on the 2022 SAFEMOBCOEN call</b></p>
<p>Call published: 13/09/2022</p>
<p>Call deadline: 18/01/2023</p>
<p>Indicative budget: EUR 150 000 000</p>
<p>Total budget requested by the applicants: EUR 74 518 455</p>
<p>Number of admissible and eligible proposals: 1</p>
<p>Number of inadmissible proposals: 4</p>
<p>Number of ineligible proposals: 0</p>
<p>Number of successful proposals: 0</p>
<p>Total budget for the successful proposals: EUR 0</p>
<p> </p>
<p><a href="https://cinea.ec.europa.eu/system/files/2023-06/Overview%20Selected%20Proposals_FINAL.pdf">List of successful projects under the 2022 CEF Transport call for proposals</a></p>
<p><a href="https://ec.europa.eu/info/funding-tenders/opportunities/portal/screen/opportunities/projects-results;programCode=CEF2027">List of funded projects under CEF</a><b></b></p>
<p> </p>
<p>For questions, please contact <a href="mailto:CINEA-CEF-TRANSPORT-CALLS@ec.europa.eu"><i>CINEA-CEF-TRANSPORT-CALLS@ec.europa.eu</i></a></p>
<p> </p>
<p>15/12/2022 11:13</p>
<p>There are few days left to finish your application in response to any of the 9 CEF Transport calls for proposals, closing on 18 January 2023 at 17:00. In total, 41 topics are open for submission on the  <a href="https://ec.europa.eu/info/funding-tenders/opportunities/portal/screen/opportunities/topic-search;callCode=null;freeTextSearchKeyword=CEF-T-2022;matchWholeText=true;typeCodes=1,0;statusCodes=31094502,31094503,31094501;programmePeriod=2021%20-%202027;programCcm2Id=43251567;programDivisionCode=null;focusAreaCode=null;destinationGroup=null;missionGroup=null;geographicalZonesCode=null;programmeDivisionProspect=null;startDateLte=null;startDateGte=null;crossCuttingPriorityCode=null;cpvCode=null;performanceOfDelivery=null;sortQuery=sortStatus;orderBy=asc;onlyTenders=false;topicListKey=topicSearchTablePageState">Funding & Tenders portal</a>.</p>
<p>We strongly advise you not to wait until the last minute to submit your application!</p>
<p>You may also see <a href="https://cinea.ec.europa.eu/funding-opportunities/calls-proposals/2022-cef-transport-call_en">the Call</a> page, and the <a href="https://cinea.ec.europa.eu/news-events/events/2022-cef-transport-call-info-day-2022-10-05_en">Info Day page</a> to find the presentations and recording of the info day session. More than 600 FAQs are now available on the <a href="https://ec.europa.eu/info/funding-tenders/opportunities/portal/screen/support/faq;type=0,1;categories=;tenders=;programme=43251567;keyword=;freeTextSearchKeyword=CEF%20Transport;matchWholeText=true;period=null;status=0;sortQuery=relevance;faqListKey=faqSearchTablePageState">FAQ support</a> on the Funding & Tenders portal.</p>
<p>To be admissible your application must contain Part A and the GIS duly completed online, and Part B uploaded on time. As indicated in section 5 of the Call document – also available on the <a href="https://ec.europa.eu/info/funding-tenders/opportunities/portal/screen/how-to-participate/reference-documents">Reference Documents</a> of the portal, <b>the mandatory annexes must also be submitted</b>. These documents concern:</p>
<p>-          Agreement by the concerned Member States benefitting from the project  – for all applications</p>
<p>-          Calculator for ERTMS and RFN applications or detailed budget table per Work Package for other applications</p>
<p>-          Timetable/Gantt chart – for all applications</p>
<p>-          Environmental compliance file including the required declarations for all applications (except ERTMS and RFN applications). Please see the <a href="https://ec.europa.eu/info/funding-tenders/opportunities/portal/screen/support/faq/18080">FAQ 18080</a>. </p>
<p>-          Activity reports of last year and List of previous projects - unless exempted from operational capacity check such as public bodies, member state organisations, international organisations and beneficiaries of grants under CEF1 and CEF2.    </p>
<p>In addition, if the application concerns works: </p>
<p>-          Full cost-benefit analysis (CBA) report and CBA cash flow template - only for works or mixed projects with a budget (eligible costs) above EUR 10 million - <a href="https://ec.europa.eu/info/funding-tenders/opportunities/portal/screen/support/faq/17952">unless exempted</a></p>
<p>-          Simplified CBA calculator – only for works or mixed projects with a budget (eligible costs) below EUR 10 million - <a href="https://ec.europa.eu/info/funding-tenders/opportunities/portal/screen/support/faq/17952">unless exempted</a></p>

title: Safe and secure parking infrastructure - works
callTitle: CEF 2 Transport - Actions related to safe and secure mobility - Cohesion envelope
descriptionByte:
Objective:

The general objective is to modernise transport infrastructure on the Core and Comprehensive Networks of the TEN-T.

Scope:

In accordance with the Article 9(2)(b)(vii) of the CEF Regulation, the following works will be supported:

  • works aiming at the development of new safe and secure parking areas to be certified in accordance with Delegated Regulation (EU) 2022/1012[1] (including safety and security Information and Communication Technologies) which are located on the road Core network and its nodes, or on the road Comprehensive network if they primarily serve users of the road Core network, for trucks and commercial vehicles.
  • works aiming at upgrading the safety and security of existing parking areas certified or to be certified in accordance with Delegated Regulation (EU) 2022/1012[1] (including safety and security Information and Communication Technologies), which are located on the road Core network and its nodes, or on the road Comprehensive network if they primarily serve users of the road Core network, for trucks and commercial vehicles. ;
  • works optimising the use of existing safe and secure parking areas for trucks and commercial vehicles through static and dynamic information including the collection, processing and dissemination of parking information. These interventions shall comply with Commission Delegated Regulation No (EU) 885/2013 (Commission Delegated Regulation No (EU) 885/2013 of 15 May 2013 supplementing ITS Directive 2010/40/EU of the European Parliament and the Council with regard to the provision of information services for safe and secure parking places for trucks and commercial vehicles (OJ L 247, 18.9.2013, p. 1)) and apply Union standards (e.g. DATEX2) and Guidelines, set up methods for measuring accurate and reliable data from sensors, cameras or other monitoring devices and analyse priority zones needed, as defined in Delegated Regulation No (EU) 885/2013, taking into account traffic conditions, infrastructure shortages or weaknesses and driving regulations.

If the project is not located directly on the Core road network or if it is located on the Comprehensive road network, the application has to justify its utility for the functioning of the Core Network. Only elements of the safe and secure parking area laid down in the service and security levels of the standards set out in Delegated Regulation (EU) 2022/1012 are eligible for funding. Accessory elements not covered by the standards will not be funded.

[1] https://eur-lex.europa.eu/eli/reg_del/2022/1012

[2] https://eur-lex.europa.eu/eli/reg_del/2022/1012

<p><b>Information update on the 2022 SAFEMOBCOEN call</b></p>
<p>Call published: 13/09/2022</p>
<p>Call deadline: 18/01/2023</p>
<p>Indicative budget: EUR 150 000 000</p>
<p>Total budget requested by the applicants: EUR 74 518 455</p>
<p>Number of admissible and eligible proposals: 1</p>
<p>Number of inadmissible proposals: 4</p>
<p>Number of ineligible proposals: 0</p>
<p>Number of successful proposals: 0</p>
<p>Total budget for the successful proposals: EUR 0</p>
<p> </p>
<p><a href="https://cinea.ec.europa.eu/system/files/2023-06/Overview%20Selected%20Proposals_FINAL.pdf">List of successful projects under the 2022 CEF Transport call for proposals</a></p>

<p> </p>
<p>For questions, please contact <a href="mailto:CINEA-CEF-TRANSPORT-CALLS@ec.europa.eu"><i>CINEA-CEF-TRANSPORT-CALLS@ec.europa.eu</i></a></p>
<p> </p>
<p>15/12/2022 11:13</p>
<p>There are few days left to finish your application in response to any of the 9 CEF Transport calls for proposals, closing on 18 January 2023 at 17:00. In total, 41 topics are open for submission on the  <a href="https://ec.europa.eu/info/funding-tenders/opportunities/portal/screen/opportunities/topic-search;callCode=null;freeTextSearchKeyword=CEF-T-2022;matchWholeText=true;typeCodes=1,0;statusCodes=31094502,31094503,31094501;programmePeriod=2021%20-%202027;programCcm2Id=43251567;programDivisionCode=null;focusAreaCode=null;destinationGroup=null;missionGroup=null;geographicalZonesCode=null;programmeDivisionProspect=null;startDateLte=null;startDateGte=null;crossCuttingPriorityCode=null;cpvCode=null;performanceOfDelivery=null;sortQuery=sortStatus;orderBy=asc;onlyTenders=false;topicListKey=topicSearchTablePageState">Funding & Tenders portal</a>.</p>
<p>We strongly advise you not to wait until the last minute to submit your application!</p>
<p>You may also see <a href="https://cinea.ec.europa.eu/funding-opportunities/calls-proposals/2022-cef-transport-call_en">the Call</a> page, and the <a href="https://cinea.ec.europa.eu/news-events/events/2022-cef-transport-call-info-day-2022-10-05_en">Info Day page</a> to find the presentations and recording of the info day session. More than 600 FAQs are now available on the <a href="https://ec.europa.eu/info/funding-tenders/opportunities/portal/screen/support/faq;type=0,1;categories=;tenders=;programme=43251567;keyword=;freeTextSearchKeyword=CEF%20Transport;matchWholeText=true;period=null;status=0;sortQuery=relevance;faqListKey=faqSearchTablePageState">FAQ support</a> on the Funding & Tenders portal.</p>
<p>To be admissible your application must contain Part A and the GIS duly completed online, and Part B uploaded on time. As indicated in section 5 of the Call document – also available on the <a href="https://ec.europa.eu/info/funding-tenders/opportunities/portal/screen/how-to-participate/reference-documents">Reference Documents</a> of the portal, <b>the mandatory annexes must also be submitted</b>. These documents concern:</p>
<p>-          Agreement by the concerned Member States benefitting from the project  – for all applications</p>
<p>-          Calculator for ERTMS and RFN applications or detailed budget table per Work Package for other applications</p>
<p>-          Timetable/Gantt chart – for all applications</p>
<p>-          Environmental compliance file including the required declarations for all applications (except ERTMS and RFN applications). Please see the <a href="https://ec.europa.eu/info/funding-tenders/opportunities/portal/screen/support/faq/18080">FAQ 18080</a>. </p>
<p>-          Activity reports of last year and List of previous projects - unless exempted from operational capacity check such as public bodies, member state organisations, international organisations and beneficiaries of grants under CEF1 and CEF2.    </p>
<p>In addition, if the application concerns works: </p>
<p>-          Full cost-benefit analysis (CBA) report and CBA cash flow template - only for works or mixed projects with a budget (eligible costs) above EUR 10 million - <a href="https://ec.europa.eu/info/funding-tenders/opportunities/portal/screen/support/faq/17952">unless exempted</a></p>
<p>-          Simplified CBA calculator – only for works or mixed projects with a budget (eligible costs) below EUR 10 million - <a href="https://ec.europa.eu/info/funding-tenders/opportunities/portal/screen/support/faq/17952">unless exempted</a></p>

<p>To be admissible your application must contain Part A and the GIS duly completed online, and Part B uploaded on time. These documents concern:</p>
<p>-          Agreement by the concerned Member States benefitting from the project  – for all applications</p>
<p>-          Calculator for ERTMS and RFN applications or detailed budget table per Work Package for other applications</p>
<p>-          Timetable/Gantt chart – for all applications</p>
<p>-          Environmental compliance file including the required declarations for all applications (except ERTMS and RFN applications). Please see the <a href="https://ec.europa.eu/info/funding-tenders/opportunities/portal/screen/support/faq/18080">FAQ 18080</a>. </p>
<p>-          Activity reports of last year and List of previous projects - unless exempted from operational capacity check such as public bodies, member state organisations, international organisations and beneficiaries of grants under CEF1 and CEF2.    </p>
<p>In addition, if the application concerns works: </p>
<p>-          Full cost-benefit analysis (CBA) report and CBA cash flow template - only for works or mixed projects with a budget (eligible costs) above EUR 10 million - <a href="https://ec.europa.eu/info/funding-tenders/opportunities/portal/screen/support/faq/17952">unless exempted</a></p>
<p>-          Simplified CBA calculator – only for works or mixed projects with a budget (eligible costs) below EUR 10 million - <a href="https://ec.europa.eu/info/funding-tenders/opportunities/portal/screen/support/faq/17952">unless exempted</a></p>

title: Improving transport infrastructure resilience - studies, works or mixed
callTitle: CEF 2 Transport - Actions related to safe and secure mobility - Cohesion envelope
descriptionByte:
Objective:

The general objective is to modernise transport infrastructure on the Core and Comprehensive Networks of the TEN-T.

Scope:

In accordance with Article 9(2)(b)(viii) of the CEF Regulation, the following projects will be supported:

  • studies and / or works related to the improvement of transport infrastructure resilience, in particular to climate change and natural disasters through infrastructure upgrades or smart monitoring systems are eligible if the applicant can demonstrate high risks associated with no project and that the project is in accordance with the National Adaptation Plan or Strategy of the Member State concerned. Improvement of transport infrastructure resilience may also be eligible as part of projects supported under sections 6.1 and 6.2. of the CEF2- Transport multiannual work program 2021-2023 (call ID’s: CEF-T-2022-CORECOEN, CEF-T-2022-COMPCOEN, CEF-T-2022-SIMOBCOEN, CEF-T-2022-SUSTMOBCOEN, CEF-T-2022-AFIFCOEN and CEF-T-2022-SAFEMOBCOEN).

Projects aimed at improving transport infrastructure resilience against cyber security threats may only be eligible as part of projects supported under above mentioned sections 6.1 and 6.2, if relevant.

<p>There are few days left to finish your application in response to any of the 9 CEF Transport calls for proposals, closing on 18 January 2023 at 17:00. <p>We strongly advise you not to wait until the last minute to submit your application!</p>
<p>You may also see <a href="https://cinea.ec.europa.eu/funding-opportunities/calls-proposals/2022-cef-transport-call_en">the Call</a> page, and the <a href="https://cinea.ec.europa.eu/news-events/events/2022-cef-transport-call-info-day-2022-10-05_en">Info Day page</a> to find the presentations and recording of the info day session. <p>To be admissible your application must contain Part A and the GIS duly completed online, and Part B uploaded on time. As indicated in section 5 of the Call document – also available on the <a href="https://ec.europa.eu/info/funding-tenders/opportunities/portal/screen/how-to-participate/reference-documents">Reference Documents</a> of the portal, <b>the mandatory annexes must also be submitted</b>. These documents concern:</p>
<p>-          Agreement by the concerned Member States benefitting from the project  – for all applications</p>
<p>-          Calculator for ERTMS and RFN applications or detailed budget table per Work Package for other applications</p>
<p>-          Timetable/Gantt chart – for all applications</p>
<p>-          Environmental compliance file including the required declarations for all applications (except ERTMS and RFN applications). Please see the <a href="https://ec.europa.eu/info/funding-tenders/opportunities/portal/screen/support/faq/18080">FAQ 18080</a>. </p>
<p>-          Activity reports of last year and List of previous projects - unless exempted from operational capacity check such as public bodies, member state organisations, international organisations and beneficiaries of grants under CEF1 and CEF2.    </p>
<p>In addition, if the application concerns works: </p>
<p>-          Full cost-benefit analysis (CBA) report and CBA cash flow template - only for works or mixed projects with a budget (eligible costs) above EUR 10 million - <a href="https://ec.europa.eu/info/funding-tenders/opportunities/portal/screen/support/faq/17952">unless exempted</a></p>
<p>-          Simplified CBA calculator – only for works or mixed projects with a budget (eligible costs) below EUR 10 million - <a href="https://ec.europa.eu/info/funding-tenders/opportunities/portal/screen/support/faq/17952">unless exempted</a></p>

These documents concern:</p>
<p>-          Agreement by the concerned Member States benefitting from the project  – for all applications</p>
<p>-          Calculator for ERTMS and RFN applications or detailed budget table per Work Package for other applications</p>
<p>-          Timetable/Gantt chart – for all applications</p>
<p>-          Environmental compliance file including the required declarations for all applications (except ERTMS and RFN applications). Please see the <a href="https://ec.europa.eu/info/funding-tenders/opportunities/portal/screen/support/faq/18080">FAQ 18080</a>. </p>
<p>-          Activity reports of last year and List of previous projects - unless exempted from operational capacity check such as public bodies, member state organisations, international organisations and beneficiaries of grants under CEF1 and CEF2.    </p>
<p>In addition, if the application concerns works: </p>
<p>-          Full cost-benefit analysis (CBA) report and CBA cash flow template - only for works or mixed projects with a budget (eligible costs) above EUR 10 million - <a href="https://ec.europa.eu/info/funding-tenders/opportunities/portal/screen/support/faq/17952">unless exempted</a></p>
<p>-          Simplified CBA calculator – only for works or mixed projects with a budget (eligible costs) below EUR 10 million - <a href="https://ec.europa.eu/info/funding-tenders/opportunities/portal/screen/support/faq/17952">unless exempted</a></p>

title: Road safety - studies, works or mixed
callTitle: CEF 2 Transport - Actions related to safe and secure mobility - Cohesion envelope
descriptionByte:
Objective:

The general objective is to modernise transport infrastructure on the Core and Comprehensive Networks of the TEN-T.

Scope:

In accordance with Article 9(2)(b)(vii) of the CEF Regulation, the following projects will be supported:

  • studies and / or works related to the upgrading of existing road sections of the core and comprehensive network road infrastructure with poor safety rating or high accident occurrence, with a view to increasing their safety. Such projects may include:
    • systemic improvements to the in-built safety of roads;
    • implementation of measures identified during the network-wide road safety assessment in accordance with Directive 2008/96/EC as amended by Directive (EU) 2019/1936;
    • upgrades of most critical and accident-prone sections (“hot spots”) as identified in the network-wide road safety assessment in accordance with in accordance with Directive 2008/96/EC as amended by Directive (EU) 2019/1936;
    • deploying digital information systems for the safe road and road tunnel use and/or enforcement purposes.

Support will only be given to projects providing for safety upgrades of existing road infrastructure, not to the construction of new road infrastructure. Support will be given to the deployment of digital infrastructure, if it has the purpose of improving of road safety and tunnel safety or if it supports authorities in enforcing road safety. Systemic improvements to the in-built safety of roads will be supported, if the intervention is based on findings of the targeted road safety inspections or of the network-wide road safety assessments in accordance with Directive 2008/96/EC as amended by Directive (EU) 2019/1936.

<p>15/12/2022 11:11</p>
<p>There are few days left to finish your application in response to any of the 9 CEF Transport calls for proposals, closing on 18 January 2023 at 17:00. In total, 41 topics are open for submission on the  <a href="https://ec.europa.eu/info/funding-tenders/opportunities/portal/screen/opportunities/topic-search;callCode=null;freeTextSearchKeyword=CEF-T-2022;matchWholeText=true;typeCodes=1,0;statusCodes=31094502,31094503,31094501;programmePeriod=2021%20-%202027;programCcm2Id=43251567;programDivisionCode=null;focusAreaCode=null;destinationGroup=null;missionGroup=null;geographicalZonesCode=null;programmeDivisionProspect=null;startDateLte=null;startDateGte=null;crossCuttingPriorityCode=null;cpvCode=null;performanceOfDelivery=null;sortQuery=sortStatus;orderBy=asc;onlyTenders=false;topicListKey=topicSearchTablePageState">Funding & Tenders portal</a>.</p>
<p>We strongly advise you not to wait until the last minute to submit your application!</p>
<p>You may also see <a href="https://cinea.ec.europa.eu/funding-opportunities/calls-proposals/2022-cef-transport-call_en">the Call</a> page, and the <a href="https://cinea.ec.europa.eu/news-events/events/2022-cef-transport-call-info-day-2022-10-05_en">Info Day page</a> to find the presentations and recording of the info day session. More than 600 FAQs are now available on the <a href="https://ec.europa.eu/info/funding-tenders/opportunities/portal/screen/support/faq;type=0,1;categories=;tenders=;programme=43251567;keyword=;freeTextSearchKeyword=CEF%20Transport;matchWholeText=true;period=null;status=0;sortQuery=relevance;faqListKey=faqSearchTablePageState">FAQ support</a> on the Funding & Tenders portal.</p>
<p>To be admissible your application must contain Part A and the GIS duly completed online, and Part B uploaded on time. As indicated in section 5 of the Call document – also available on the <a href="https://ec.europa.eu/info/funding-tenders/opportunities/portal/screen/how-to-participate/reference-documents">Reference Documents</a> of the portal, <b>the mandatory annexes must also be submitted</b>. These documents concern:</p>
<p>-          Agreement by the concerned Member States benefitting from the project  – for all applications</p>
<p>-          Calculator for ERTMS and RFN applications or detailed budget table per Work Package for other applications</p>
<p>-          Timetable/Gantt chart – for all applications</p>
<p>-          Environmental compliance file including the required declarations for all applications (except ERTMS and RFN applications). Please see the <a href="https://ec.europa.eu/info/funding-tenders/opportunities/portal/screen/support/faq/18080">FAQ 18080</a>. </p>
<p>-          Activity reports of last year and List of previous projects - unless exempted from operational capacity check such as public bodies, member state organisations, international organisations and beneficiaries of grants under CEF1 and CEF2.    </p>
<p>In addition, if the application concerns works: </p>
<p>-          Full cost-benefit analysis (CBA) report and CBA cash flow template - only for works or mixed projects with a budget (eligible costs) above EUR 10 million - <a href="https://ec.europa.eu/info/funding-tenders/opportunities/portal/screen/support/faq/17952">unless exempted</a></p>
<p>-          Simplified CBA calculator – only for works or mixed projects with a budget (eligible costs) below EUR 10 million - <a href="https://ec.europa.eu/info/funding-tenders/opportunities/portal/screen/support/faq/17952">unless exempted</a></p>

<p>We strongly advise you not to wait until the last minute to submit your application!</p>
<p>You may also see <a href="https://cinea.ec.europa.eu/funding-opportunities/calls-proposals/2022-cef-transport-call_en">the Call</a> page, and the <a href="https://cinea.ec.europa.eu/news-events/events/2022-cef-transport-call-info-day-2022-10-05_en">Info Day page</a> to find the presentations and recording of the info day session. More than 600 FAQs are now available on the <a href="https://ec.europa.eu/info/funding-tenders/opportunities/portal/screen/support/faq;type=0,1;categories=;tenders=;programme=43251567;keyword=;freeTextSearchKeyword=CEF%20Transport;matchWholeText=true;period=null;status=0;sortQuery=relevance;faqListKey=faqSearchTablePageState">FAQ support</a> on the Funding & Tenders portal.</p>
<p>To be admissible your application must contain Part A and the GIS duly completed online, and Part B uploaded on time. As indicated in section 5 of the Call document – also available on the <a href="https://ec.europa.eu/info/funding-tenders/opportunities/portal/screen/how-to-participate/reference-documents">Reference Documents</a> of the portal, <b>the mandatory annexes must also be submitted</b>. These documents concern:</p>
<p>-          Agreement by the concerned Member States benefitting from the project  – for all applications</p>
<p>-          Calculator for ERTMS and RFN applications or detailed budget table per Work Package for other applications</p>
<p>-          Timetable/Gantt chart – for all applications</p>
<p>-          Environmental compliance file including the required declarations for all applications (except ERTMS and RFN applications). Please see the <a href="https://ec.europa.eu/info/funding-tenders/opportunities/portal/screen/support/faq/18080">FAQ 18080</a>. </p>
<p>-          Activity reports of last year and List of previous projects - unless exempted from operational capacity check such as public bodies, member state organisations, international organisations and beneficiaries of grants under CEF1 and CEF2.    </p>
<p>In addition, if the application concerns works: </p>
<p>-          Full cost-benefit analysis (CBA) report and CBA cash flow template - only for works or mixed projects with a budget (eligible costs) above EUR 10 million - <a href="https://ec.europa.eu/info/funding-tenders/opportunities/portal/screen/support/faq/17952">unless exempted</a></p>
<p>-          Simplified CBA calculator – only for works or mixed projects with a budget (eligible costs) below EUR 10 million - <a href="https://ec.europa.eu/info/funding-tenders/opportunities/portal/screen/support/faq/17952">unless exempted</a></p>

title: Adapting the transport infrastructure for Union external border checks purposes - studies, works or mixed
callTitle: CEF 2 Transport - Actions related to safe and secure mobility - General envelope
descriptionByte:
Objective:

The general objective is to modernise transport infrastructure on the Core and Comprehensive Networks of the TEN-T.

Scope:

In accordance with Article 9(2)(b)(x) of the CEF Regulation, the following projects will be supported:

  • studies and / or works aiming at facilitating traffic flows for all land and waterborne transport modes at border controls areas at the Union external border of the TEN-T network in accordance with Article 9(2)(b)(x) of the CEF Regulation. The supported projects, targeting only the transport infrastructure, will inter alia improve the connections to the border crossing points, and parking lines and spaces related to the border control. Where relevant, coordination with relevant Interreg IPA-CBC programmes should be ensured by the applicants.

<p>We strongly advise you not to wait until the last minute to submit your application!</p>
<p>You may also see <a href="https://cinea.ec.europa.eu/funding-opportunities/calls-proposals/2022-cef-transport-call_en">the Call</a> page, and the <a href="https://cinea.ec.europa.eu/news-events/events/2022-cef-transport-call-info-day-2022-10-05_en">Info Day page</a> to find the presentations and recording of the info day session. More than 600 FAQs are now available on the <a href="https://ec.europa.eu/info/funding-tenders/opportunities/portal/screen/support/faq;type=0,1;categories=;tenders=;programme=43251567;keyword=;freeTextSearchKeyword=CEF%20Transport;matchWholeText=true;period=null;status=0;sortQuery=relevance;faqListKey=faqSearchTablePageState">FAQ support</a> on the Funding & Tenders portal.</p>
<p>To be admissible your application must contain Part A and the GIS duly completed online, and Part B uploaded on time. As indicated in section 5 of the Call document – also available on the <a href="https://ec.europa.eu/info/funding-tenders/opportunities/portal/screen/how-to-participate/reference-documents">Reference Documents</a> of the portal, <b>the mandatory annexes must also be submitted</b>. These documents concern:</p>
<p>-          Agreement by the concerned Member States benefitting from the project  – for all applications</p>
<p>-          Calculator for ERTMS and RFN applications or detailed budget table per Work Package for other applications</p>
<p>-          Timetable/Gantt chart – for all applications</p>
<p>-          Environmental compliance file including the required declarations for all applications (except ERTMS and RFN applications). Please see the <a href="https://ec.europa.eu/info/funding-tenders/opportunities/portal/screen/support/faq/18080">FAQ 18080</a>. </p>
<p>-          Activity reports of last year and List of previous projects - unless exempted from operational capacity check such as public bodies, member state organisations, international organisations and beneficiaries of grants under CEF1 and CEF2.    </p>
<p>In addition, if the application concerns works: </p>
<p>-          Full cost-benefit analysis (CBA) report and CBA cash flow template - only for works or mixed projects with a budget (eligible costs) above EUR 10 million - <a href="https://ec.europa.eu/info/funding-tenders/opportunities/portal/screen/support/faq/17952">unless exempted</a></p>
<p>-          Simplified CBA calculator – only for works or mixed projects with a budget (eligible costs) below EUR 10 million - <a href="https://ec.europa.eu/info/funding-tenders/opportunities/portal/screen/support/faq/17952">unless exempted</a></p>

title: Safe and secure parking infrastructure - works
callTitle: CEF 2 Transport - Actions related to safe and secure mobility - General envelope
descriptionByte:
Objective:

The general objective is to modernise transport infrastructure on the Core and Comprehensive Networks of the TEN-T.

Scope:

In accordance with the Article 9(2)(b)(vii) of the CEF Regulation, the following works will be supported:

  • works aiming at the development of new safe and secure parking areas to be certified in accordance with Delegated Regulation (EU) 2022/1012[1] (including safety and security Information and Communication Technologies) which are located on the road Core network and its nodes, or on the road Comprehensive network if they primarily serve users of the road Core network, for trucks and commercial vehicles.
  • works aiming at upgrading the safety and security of existing parking areas certified or to be certified in accordance with Delegated Regulation (EU) 2022/1012[1] (including safety and security Information and Communication Technologies), which are located on the road Core network and its nodes, or on the road Comprehensive network if they primarily serve users of the road Core network, for trucks and commercial vehicles.
  • works optimising the use of existing safe and secure parking areas for trucks and commercial vehicles through static and dynamic information including the collection, processing and dissemination of parking information. These interventions shall comply with Commission Delegated Regulation No (EU) 885/2013 (Commission Delegated Regulation No (EU) 885/2013 of 15 May 2013 supplementing ITS Directive 2010/40/EU of the European Parliament and the Council with regard to the provision of information services for safe and secure parking places for trucks and commercial vehicles (OJ L 247, 18.9.2013, p. 1)) and apply Union standards (e.g. DATEX2) and Guidelines, set up methods for measuring accurate and reliable data from sensors, cameras or other monitoring devices and analyse priority zones needed, as defined in Delegated Regulation No (EU) 885/2013, taking into account traffic conditions, infrastructure shortages or weaknesses and driving regulations.

If the project is not located directly on the Core road network or if it is located on the Comprehensive road network, the application has to justify its utility for the functioning of the Core Network. Only elements of the safe and secure parking area laid down in the service and security levels of the standards set out in Delegated Regulation (EU) 2022/1012 are eligible for funding. Accessory elements not covered by the standards will not be funded.

[1] https://eur-lex.europa.eu/eli/reg_del/2022/1012

[2] https://eur-lex.europa.eu/eli/reg_del/2022/1012

<p>Call deadline: 18/01/2023</p>

<p>For questions, please contact <a href="mailto:CINEA-CEF-TRANSPORT-CALLS@ec.europa.eu"><i>CINEA-CEF-TRANSPORT-CALLS@ec.europa.eu</i></a></p>

<p>15/12/2022 11:11</p>
<p>There are few days left to finish your application in response to any of the 9 CEF Transport calls for proposals, closing on 18 January 2023 at 17:00. In total, 41 topics are open for submission on the  <a href="https://ec.europa.eu/info/funding-tenders/opportunities/portal/screen/opportunities/topic-search;callCode=null;freeTextSearchKeyword=CEF-T-2022;matchWholeText=true;typeCodes=1,0;statusCodes=31094502,31094503,31094501;programmePeriod=2021%20-%202027;programCcm2Id=43251567;programDivisionCode=null;focusAreaCode=null;destinationGroup=null;missionGroup=null;geographicalZonesCode=null;programmeDivisionProspect=null;startDateLte=null;startDateGte=null;crossCuttingPriorityCode=null;cpvCode=null;performanceOfDelivery=null;sortQuery=sortStatus;orderBy=asc;onlyTenders=false;topicListKey=topicSearchTablePageState">Funding & Tenders portal</a>.</p>
<p>We strongly advise you not to wait until the last minute to submit your application!</p>
<p>You may also see <a href="https://cinea.ec.europa.eu/funding-opportunities/calls-proposals/2022-cef-transport-call_en">the Call</a> page, and the <a href="https://cinea.ec.europa.eu/news-events/events/2022-cef-transport-call-info-day-2022-10-05_en">Info Day page</a> to find the presentations and recording of the info day session. More than 600 FAQs are now available on the <a href="https://ec.europa.eu/info/funding-tenders/opportunities/portal/screen/support/faq;type=0,1;categories=;tenders=;programme=43251567;keyword=;freeTextSearchKeyword=CEF%20Transport;matchWholeText=true;period=null;status=0;sortQuery=relevance;faqListKey=faqSearchTablePageState">FAQ support</a> on the Funding & Tenders portal.</p>
<p>To be admissible your application must contain Part A and the GIS duly completed online, and Part B uploaded on time. As indicated in section 5 of the Call document – also available on the <a href="https://ec.europa.eu/info/funding-tenders/opportunities/portal/screen/how-to-participate/reference-documents">Reference Documents</a> of the portal, <b>the mandatory annexes must also be submitted</b>. These documents concern:</p>
<p>-          Agreement by the concerned Member States benefitting from the project  – for all applications</p>
<p>-          Calculator for ERTMS and RFN applications or detailed budget table per Work Package for other applications</p>
<p>-          Timetable/Gantt chart – for all applications</p>
<p>-          Environmental compliance file including the required declarations for all applications (except ERTMS and RFN applications). Please see the <a href="https://ec.europa.eu/info/funding-tenders/opportunities/portal/screen/support/faq/18080">FAQ 18080</a>. </p>
<p>-          Activity reports of last year and List of previous projects - unless exempted from operational capacity check such as public bodies, member state organisations, international organisations and beneficiaries of grants under CEF1 and CEF2.    </p>
<p>In addition, if the application concerns works: </p>
<p>-          Full cost-benefit analysis (CBA) report and CBA cash flow template - only for works or mixed projects with a budget (eligible costs) above EUR 10 million - <a href="https://ec.europa.eu/info/funding-tenders/opportunities/portal/screen/support/faq/17952">unless exempted</a></p>
<p>-          Simplified CBA calculator – only for works or mixed projects with a budget (eligible costs) below EUR 10 million - <a href="https://ec.europa.eu/info/funding-tenders/opportunities/portal/screen/support/faq/17952">unless exempted</a></p>

<p>We strongly advise you not to wait until the last minute to submit your application!</p>
<p>You may also see <a href="https://cinea.ec.europa.eu/funding-opportunities/calls-proposals/2022-cef-transport-call_en">the Call</a> page, and the <a href="https://cinea.ec.europa.eu/news-events/events/2022-cef-transport-call-info-day-2022-10-05_en">Info Day page</a> to find the presentations and recording of the info day session. More than 600 FAQs are now available on the <a href="https://ec.europa.eu/info/funding-tenders/opportunities/portal/screen/support/faq;type=0,1;categories=;tenders=;programme=43251567;keyword=;freeTextSearchKeyword=CEF%20Transport;matchWholeText=true;period=null;status=0;sortQuery=relevance;faqListKey=faqSearchTablePageState">FAQ support</a> on the Funding & Tenders portal.</p>
<p>To be admissible your application must contain Part A and the GIS duly completed online, and Part B uploaded on time. As indicated in section 5 of the Call document – also available on the <a href="https://ec.europa.eu/info/funding-tenders/opportunities/portal/screen/how-to-participate/reference-documents">Reference Documents</a> of the portal, <b>the mandatory annexes must also be submitted</b>. These documents concern:</p>
<p>-          Agreement by the concerned Member States benefitting from the project  – for all applications</p>
<p>-          Calculator for ERTMS and RFN applications or detailed budget table per Work Package for other applications</p>
<p>-          Timetable/Gantt chart – for all applications</p>
<p>-          Environmental compliance file including the required declarations for all applications (except ERTMS and RFN applications). Please see the <a href="https://ec.europa.eu/info/funding-tenders/opportunities/portal/screen/support/faq/18080">FAQ 18080</a>. </p>
<p>-          Activity reports of last year and List of previous projects - unless exempted from operational capacity check such as public bodies, member state organisations, international organisations and beneficiaries of grants under CEF1 and CEF2.    </p>
<p>In addition, if the application concerns works: </p>
<p>-          Full cost-benefit analysis (CBA) report and CBA cash flow template - only for works or mixed projects with a budget (eligible costs) above EUR 10 million - <a href="https://ec.europa.eu/info/funding-tenders/opportunities/portal/screen/support/faq/17952">unless exempted</a></p>
<p>-          Simplified CBA calculator – only for works or mixed projects with a budget (eligible costs) below EUR 10 million - <a href="https://ec.europa.eu/info/funding-tenders/opportunities/portal/screen/support/faq/17952">unless exempted</a></p>

callTitle: CEF 2 Transport - Actions related to safe and secure mobility - General envelope
descriptionByte:
Objective:

The general objective is to modernise transport infrastructure on the Core and Comprehensive Networks of the TEN-T.

Scope:

In accordance with Article 9(2)(b)(viii) of the CEF Regulation, the following projects will be supported:

  • studies and / or works for the improvement of transport infrastructure resilience, in particular to climate change and natural disasters through infrastructure upgrades or smart monitoring systems are eligible if the applicant can demonstrate high risks associated with no project and that the project is in accordance with the National Adaptation Plan or Strategy of the Member State concerned. Improvement of transport infrastructure resilience may also be eligible as part of projects supported under sections 6.1 and 6.2 of the CEF2- Transport multiannual work program 2021-2023 (call ID’s: CEF-T-2022-COREGEN, CEF-T-2022-COMPGEN, CEF-T-2022-SIMOBGEN, CEF-T-2022-SUSTMOBGEN, CEF-T-2022-AFIFGEN and CEF-T-2022-SAFEMOBGEN).

Projects aimed at improving transport infrastructure resilience against cyber security threats may only be eligible as part of projects supported under above mentioned sections 6.1 and 6.2, if relevant.

<p><b>Information update on the 2022 SIMOBCOEN call</b></p>
<p>Call published: 13/09/2022</p>
<p>Call deadline: 18/01/2023</p>
<p>Indicative budget: EUR 150 000 000</p>
<p>Total budget requested by the applicants: EUR 51 177 075</p>
<p>Number of admissible and eligible proposals: 5</p>
<p>Number of inadmissible proposals: 0</p>
<p>Number of ineligible proposals: 0</p>
<p>Number of successful proposals: 4</p>
<p>Total budget for the successful proposals: EUR 49 945 000</p>
<p> </p>
<p><a href="https://cinea.ec.europa.eu/system/files/2023-06/Overview%20Selected%20Proposals_FINAL.pdf">List of successful projects under the 2022 CEF Transport call for proposals</a></p>
<p><a href="https://ec.europa.eu/info/funding-tenders/opportunities/portal/screen/opportunities/projects-results;programCode=CEF2027">List of funded projects under CEF</a><b></b></p>
<p> </p>
<p>For questions, please contact <a href="mailto:CINEA-CEF-TRANSPORT-CALLS@ec.europa.eu"><i>CINEA-CEF-TRANSPORT-CALLS@ec.europa.eu</i></a></p>

<p>There are few days left to finish your application in response to any of the 9 CEF Transport calls for proposals, closing on 18 January 2023 at 17:00. In total, 41 topics are open for submission on the  <a href="https://ec.europa.eu/info/funding-tenders/opportunities/portal/screen/opportunities/topic-search;callCode=null;freeTextSearchKeyword=CEF-T-2022;matchWholeText=true;typeCodes=1,0;statusCodes=31094502,31094503,31094501;programmePeriod=2021%20-%202027;programCcm2Id=43251567;programDivisionCode=null;focusAreaCode=null;destinationGroup=null;missionGroup=null;geographicalZonesCode=null;programmeDivisionProspect=null;startDateLte=null;startDateGte=null;crossCuttingPriorityCode=null;cpvCode=null;performanceOfDelivery=null;sortQuery=sortStatus;orderBy=asc;onlyTenders=false;topicListKey=topicSearchTablePageState">Funding & Tenders portal</a>.</p>
<p>We strongly advise you not to wait until the last minute to submit your application!</p>
<p>You may also see <a href="https://cinea.ec.europa.eu/funding-opportunities/calls-proposals/2022-cef-transport-call_en">the Call</a> page, and the <a href="https://cinea.ec.europa.eu/news-events/events/2022-cef-transport-call-info-day-2022-10-05_en">Info Day page</a> to find the presentations and recording of the info day session. More than 600 FAQs are now available on the <a href="https://ec.europa.eu/info/funding-tenders/opportunities/portal/screen/support/faq;type=0,1;categories=;tenders=;programme=43251567;keyword=;freeTextSearchKeyword=CEF%20Transport;matchWholeText=true;period=null;status=0;sortQuery=relevance;faqListKey=faqSearchTablePageState">FAQ support</a> on the Funding & Tenders portal.</p>
<p>To be admissible your application must contain Part A and the GIS duly completed online, and Part B uploaded on time. As indicated in section 5 of the Call document – also available on the <a href="https://ec.europa.eu/info/funding-tenders/opportunities/portal/screen/how-to-participate/reference-documents">Reference Documents</a> of the portal, <b>the mandatory annexes must also be submitted</b>. These documents concern:</p>
<p>-          Agreement by the concerned Member States benefitting from the project  – for all applications</p>
<p>-          Calculator for ERTMS and RFN applications or detailed budget table per Work Package for other applications</p>
<p>-          Timetable/Gantt chart – for all applications</p>
<p>-          Environmental compliance file including the required declarations for all applications (except ERTMS and RFN applications). Please see the <a href="https://ec.europa.eu/info/funding-tenders/opportunities/portal/screen/support/faq/18080">FAQ 18080</a>. </p>
<p>-          Activity reports of last year and List of previous projects - unless exempted from operational capacity check such as public bodies, member state organisations, international organisations and beneficiaries of grants under CEF1 and CEF2.    </p>
<p>In addition, if the application concerns works: </p>
<p>-          Full cost-benefit analysis (CBA) report and CBA cash flow template - only for works or mixed projects with a budget (eligible costs) above EUR 10 million - <a href="https://ec.europa.eu/info/funding-tenders/opportunities/portal/screen/support/faq/17952">unless exempted</a></p>
<p>-          Simplified CBA calculator – only for works or mixed projects with a budget (eligible costs) below EUR 10 million - <a href="https://ec.europa.eu/info/funding-tenders/opportunities/portal/screen/support/faq/17952">unless exempted</a></p>

<p>There are few days left to finish your application in response to any of the 9 CEF Transport calls for proposals, closing on 18 January 2023 at 17:00. In total, 41 topics are open for submission on the  <a href="https://ec.europa.eu/info/funding-tenders/opportunities/portal/screen/opportunities/topic-search;callCode=null;freeTextSearchKeyword=CEF-T-2022;matchWholeText=true;typeCodes=1,0;statusCodes=31094502,31094503,31094501;programmePeriod=2021%20-%202027;programCcm2Id=43251567;programDivisionCode=null;focusAreaCode=null;destinationGroup=null;missionGroup=null;geographicalZonesCode=null;programmeDivisionProspect=null;startDateLte=null;startDateGte=null;crossCuttingPriorityCode=null;cpvCode=null;performanceOfDelivery=null;sortQuery=sortStatus;orderBy=asc;onlyTenders=false;topicListKey=topicSearchTablePageState">Funding & Tenders portal</a>.</p>
<p>We strongly advise you not to wait until the last minute to submit your application!</p>
<p>You may also see <a href="https://cinea.ec.europa.eu/funding-opportunities/calls-proposals/2022-cef-transport-call_en">the Call</a> page, and the <a href="https://cinea.ec.europa.eu/news-events/events/2022-cef-transport-call-info-day-2022-10-05_en">Info Day page</a> to find the presentations and recording of the info day session. More than 600 FAQs are now available on the <a href="https://ec.europa.eu/info/funding-tenders/opportunities/portal/screen/support/faq;type=0,1;categories=;tenders=;programme=43251567;keyword=;freeTextSearchKeyword=CEF%20Transport;matchWholeText=true;period=null;status=0;sortQuery=relevance;faqListKey=faqSearchTablePageState">FAQ support</a> on the Funding & Tenders portal.</p>
<p>To be admissible your application must contain Part A and the GIS duly completed online, and Part B uploaded on time. As indicated in section 5 of the Call document – also available on the <a href="https://ec.europa.eu/info/funding-tenders/opportunities/portal/screen/how-to-participate/reference-documents">Reference Documents</a> of the portal, <b>the mandatory annexes must also be submitted</b>. These documents concern:</p>
<p>-          Agreement by the concerned Member States benefitting from the project  – for all applications</p>
<p>-          Calculator for ERTMS and RFN applications or detailed budget table per Work Package for other applications</p>
<p>-          Timetable/Gantt chart – for all applications</p>
<p>-          Environmental compliance file including the required declarations for all applications (except ERTMS and RFN applications). Please see the <a href="https://ec.europa.eu/info/funding-tenders/opportunities/portal/screen/support/faq/18080">FAQ 18080</a>. </p>
<p>-          Activity reports of last year and List of previous projects - unless exempted from operational capacity check such as public bodies, member state organisations, international organisations and beneficiaries of grants under CEF1 and CEF2.    </p>
<p>In addition, if the application concerns works: </p>

title: ERTMS – unit contribution
callTitle: CEF 2 Transport - Actions related to smart and interoperable mobility – Cohesion envelope
descriptionByte:
Objective:

The general objective is to modernise transport infrastructure on the Core and Comprehensive Networks of the TEN-T.

Scope:

In accordance with the Article 9(2)(b)(ii) of the CEF Regulation, the following works will be supported:

  • European Rail Traffic Management Systems (ERTMS) on-board and track-side deployment with a priority to rolling out ERTMS on the entire Core Network. Actions shall be:
    • compliant with Commission Regulation (EU) No 2016/919 (Commission Regulation (EU) 2016/919 of 27 May 2016 on the technical specification for interoperability relating to the ‘control-command and signalling’ subsystems of the rail system in the European Union (OJ L 158, 15.6.2016, p. 1)) as amended by Commission Implementing Regulation 2019/776(Commission Implementing Regulation (EU) 2019/776 of 16 May 2019 amending Commission Regulations (EU) No 321/2013, (EU) No 1299/2014, (EU) No 1301/2014, (EU) No 1302/2014, (EU) No 1303/2014 and (EU) 2016/919 and Commission Implementing Decision 2011/665/EU as regards the alignment with Directive (EU) 2016/797 of the European Parliament and of the Council and the implementation of specific objectives set out in Commission Delegated Decision (EU) 2017/1474 (OJ L 139 I, 27.5.2019, p. 108)), or subsequent versions, and with Directive (EU) No 2016/797 (Directive (EU) 2016/797 of the European Parliament and of the Council of 11 May 2016 on the interoperability of the rail system within the European Union (OJ L 138, 26.5.2016, p. 44)) and Directive (EU) No 2016/798 (Directive (EU) 2016/798 of the European Parliament and of the Council of 11 May 2016 on railway safety (OJ L 138, 26.5.2016, p. 102)) or subsequent versions;
    • baseline 3 (B3) compliant - the set of specifications #2 or #3 in table A2.2 or A2.3 of the Annex of Commission Regulation (EU) No 2016/919 as amended by Commission Implementing Regulation 2019/776 (Commission Implementing Regulation (EU) 2019/776 of 16 May 2019 amending Commission Regulations (EU) No 321/2013, (EU) No 1299/2014, (EU) No 1301/2014, (EU) No 1302/2014, (EU) No 1303/2014 and (EU) 2016/919 and Commission Implementing Decision 2011/665/EU as regards the alignment with Directive (EU) 2016/797 of the European Parliament and of the Council and the implementation of specific objectives set out in Commission Delegated Decision (EU) 2017/1474 (OJ L 139 I, 27.5.2019, p. 108)), or subsequent versions;
    • supported in the form of unit contributions as defined in the Commission Decision authorising the use of unit costs to support the deployment of ERTMS under the Connecting Europe Facility (CEF) - Transport (https://ec.europa.eu/info/funding-tenders/opportunities/docs/2021-2027/cef/guidance/unit-cost-decision-cef-ertms-afif-evri-rfn_en.pdf).

Where relevant, ERTMS actions will be coordinated with 5G corridors deployment.

Where relevant, the above mentioned actions shall take into account the innovative new technologies and solutions in the fields of smart applications for transport resulting from Horizon Europe activities.

Digital platforms supported under CEF must be accessible for use by all operators on a non-discriminatory basis.

<p><b>Information update on the 2022 SIMOBCOEN call</b></p>
<p>Call published: 13/09/2022</p>
<p>Call deadline: 18/01/2023</p>
<p>Indicative budget: EUR 150 000 000</p>
<p>Total budget requested by the applicants: EUR 51 177 075</p>
<p>Number of admissible and eligible proposals: 5</p>
<p>Number of inadmissible proposals: 0</p>
<p>Number of ineligible proposals: 0</p>
<p>Number of successful proposals: 4</p>
<p>Total budget for the successful proposals: EUR 49 945 000</p>
<p> </p>
<p><a href="https://cinea.ec.europa.eu/system/files/2023-06/Overview%20Selected%20Proposals_FINAL.pdf">List of successful projects under the 2022 CEF Transport call for proposals</a></p>
<p><a href="https://ec.europa.eu/info/funding-tenders/opportunities/portal/screen/opportunities/projects-results;programCode=CEF2027">List of funded projects under CEF</a><b></b></p>
<p> </p>
<p>For questions, please contact <a href="mailto:CINEA-CEF-TRANSPORT-CALLS@ec.europa.eu"><i>CINEA-CEF-TRANSPORT-CALLS@ec.europa.eu</i></a></p>
<p> </p>
<p>15/12/2022 11:12</p>

</table>
<p>There are few days left to finish your application in response to any of the 9 CEF Transport calls for proposals, closing on 18 January 2023 at 17:00. In total, 41 topics are open for submission on the  <a href="https://ec.europa.eu/info/funding-tenders/opportunities/portal/screen/opportunities/topic-search;callCode=null;freeTextSearchKeyword=CEF-T-2022;matchWholeText=true;typeCodes=1,0;statusCodes=31094502,31094503,31094501;programmePeriod=2021%20-%202027;programCcm2Id=43251567;programDivisionCode=null;focusAreaCode=null;destinationGroup=null;missionGroup=null;geographicalZonesCode=null;programmeDivisionProspect=null;startDateLte=null;startDateGte=null;crossCuttingPriorityCode=null;cpvCode=null;performanceOfDelivery=null;sortQuery=sortStatus;orderBy=asc;onlyTenders=false;topicListKey=topicSearchTablePageState">Funding & Tenders portal</a>.</p>
<p>We strongly advise you not to wait until the last minute to submit your application!</p>
<p>You may also see <a href="https://cinea.ec.europa.eu/funding-opportunities/calls-proposals/2022-cef-transport-call_en">the Call</a> page, and the <a href="https://cinea.ec.europa.eu/news-events/events/2022-cef-transport-call-info-day-2022-10-05_en">Info Day page</a> to find the presentations and recording of the info day session. More than 600 FAQs are now available on the <a href="https://ec.europa.eu/info/funding-tenders/opportunities/portal/screen/support/faq;type=0,1;categories=;tenders=;programme=43251567;keyword=;freeTextSearchKeyword=CEF%20Transport;matchWholeText=true;period=null;status=0;sortQuery=relevance;faqListKey=faqSearchTablePageState">FAQ support</a> on the Funding & Tenders portal.</p>
<p>To be admissible your application must contain Part A and the GIS duly completed online, and Part B uploaded on time. As indicated in section 5 of the Call document – also available on the <a href="https://ec.europa.eu/info/funding-tenders/opportunities/portal/screen/how-to-participate/reference-documents">Reference Documents</a> of the portal, <b>the mandatory annexes must also be submitted</b>. These documents concern:</p>
<p>-          Agreement by the concerned Member States benefitting from the project  – for all applications</p>
<p>-          Calculator for ERTMS and RFN applications or detailed budget table per Work Package for other applications</p>
<p>-          Timetable/Gantt chart – for all applications</p>
<p>-          Environmental compliance file including the required declarations for all applications (except ERTMS and RFN applications). Please see the <a href="https://ec.europa.eu/info/funding-tenders/opportunities/portal/screen/support/faq/18080">FAQ 18080</a>. </p>
<p>-          Activity reports of last year and List of previous projects - unless exempted from operational capacity check such as public bodies, member state organisations, international organisations and beneficiaries of grants under CEF1 and CEF2.    </p>
<p>In addition, if the application concerns works: </p>
<p>-          Full cost-benefit analysis (CBA) report and CBA cash flow template - only for works or mixed projects with a budget (eligible costs) above EUR 10 million - <a href="https://ec.europa.eu/info/funding-tenders/opportunities/portal/screen/support/faq/17952">unless exempted</a></p>
<p>-          Simplified CBA calculator – only for works or mixed projects with a budget (eligible costs) below EUR 10 million - <a href="https://ec.europa.eu/info/funding-tenders/opportunities/portal/screen/support/faq/17952">unless exempted</a></p>
<p>We wish you the best of luck in your application!</p>"},{"approvalDate":"2022-12-15","lastChangeDate":"2022-12-15T11:12:33.252","content":"<!--[if gte mso 9]><xml>

<p>You may also see <a href="https://cinea.ec.europa.eu/funding-opportunities/calls-proposals/2022-cef-transport-call_en">the Call</a> page, and the <a href="https://cinea.ec.europa.eu/news-events/events/2022-cef-transport-call-info-day-2022-10-05_en">Info Day page</a> to find the presentations and recording of the info day session. More than 600 FAQs are now available on the <a href="https://ec.europa.eu/info/funding-tenders/opportunities/portal/screen/support/faq;type=0,1;categories=;tenders=;programme=43251567;keyword=;freeTextSearchKeyword=CEF%20Transport;matchWholeText=true;period=null;status=0;sortQuery=relevance;faqListKey=faqSearchTablePageState">FAQ support</a> on the Funding & Tenders portal.</p>
<p>To be admissible your application must contain Part A and the GIS duly completed online, and Part B uploaded on time. As indicated in section 5 of the Call document – also available on the <a href="https://ec.europa.eu/info/funding-tenders/opportunities/portal/screen/how-to-participate/reference-documents">Reference Documents</a> of the portal, <b>the mandatory annexes must also be submitted</b>. These documents concern:</p>
<p>-          Agreement by the concerned Member States benefitting from the project  – for all applications</p>
<p>-          Calculator for ERTMS and RFN applications or detailed budget table per Work Package for other applications</p>
<p>-          Timetable/Gantt chart – for all applications</p>
<p>-          Environmental compliance file including the required declarations for all applications (except ERTMS and RFN applications). Please see the <a href="https://ec.europa.eu/info/funding-tenders/opportunities/portal/screen/support/faq/18080">FAQ 18080</a>. </p>
<p>-          Activity reports of last year and List of previous projects - unless exempted from operational capacity check such as public bodies, member state organisations, international organisations and beneficiaries of grants under CEF1 and CEF2.    </p>
<p>In addition, if the application concerns works: </p>
<p>-          Full cost-benefit analysis (CBA) report and CBA cash flow template - only for works or mixed projects with a budget (eligible costs) above EUR 10 million - <a href="https://ec.europa.eu/info/funding-tenders/opportunities/portal/screen/support/faq/17952">unless exempted</a></p>
<p>-          Simplified CBA calculator – only for works or mixed projects with a budget (eligible costs) below EUR 10 million - <a href="https://ec.europa.eu/info/funding-tenders/opportunities/portal/screen/support/faq/17952">unless exempted</a></p>

title: Removing interoperability barriers - studies, works or mixed
callTitle: CEF 2 Transport - Actions related to smart and interoperable mobility – Cohesion envelope
descriptionByte:
Objective:

The general objective is to modernise transport infrastructure on the Core and Comprehensive Networks of the TEN-T.

Scope:

studies and / or works, related to the following Actions will be supported:

  • Actions removing interoperability barriers in compliance with the Technical Specifications for Interoperability (TSI) adopted by Directive 2016/797 on the interoperability of the rail system (Directive 2016/797 of the European Parliament and of the Council of 11 May 2016 on the interoperability of the rail system within the European Union which replaces Directive 2008/57/EC as of 16 June 2020 (OJ L 138, 26.5.2016, p. 44)), including automatic gauge-change facilities in rail freight traffic in accordance with Article 9(2)(b)(v) of the CEF Regulation, as well as terminals and their equipment necessary for the transfer between different track gauges. In particular, developments in line with the Technical Specification for Interoperability relating to Telematics Applications for Freight/Passenger Services (TAF/TAP TSIs) and other relevant TSIs such as TSI OPE or TSI Safety in tunnels will be supported.

Investments concerning rolling stock, notably the installation of sensors or other devices on wagons, will not be supported.

<p><b>Information update on the 2022 SIMOBGEN call</b></p>
<p>Call published: 13/09/2022</p>
<p>Call deadline: 18/01/2023</p>
<p>Indicative budget: EUR 400 000 000</p>
<p>Total budget requested by the applicants: EUR 1 110 153 879</p>
<p>Number of admissible and eligible proposals: 76</p>
<p>Number of inadmissible proposals: 2</p>
<p>Number of ineligible proposals: 1</p>
<p>Number of successful proposals: 20</p>
<p>Total budget for the successful proposals: EUR 399 671 139</p>
<p> </p>

<p>15/12/2022 11:10</p>
<p>There are few days left to finish your application in response to any of the 9 CEF Transport calls for proposals, closing on 18 January 2023 at 17:00. In total, 41 topics are open for submission on the  <a href="https://ec.europa.eu/info/funding-tenders/opportunities/portal/screen/opportunities/topic-search;callCode=null;freeTextSearchKeyword=CEF-T-2022;matchWholeText=true;typeCodes=1,0;statusCodes=31094502,31094503,31094501;programmePeriod=2021%20-%202027;programCcm2Id=43251567;programDivisionCode=null;focusAreaCode=null;destinationGroup=null;missionGroup=null;geographicalZonesCode=null;programmeDivisionProspect=null;startDateLte=null;startDateGte=null;crossCuttingPriorityCode=null;cpvCode=null;performanceOfDelivery=null;sortQuery=sortStatus;orderBy=asc;onlyTenders=false;topicListKey=topicSearchTablePageState">Funding & Tenders portal</a>.</p>
<p>We strongly advise you not to wait until the last minute to submit your application!</p>
<p>You may also see <a href="https://cinea.ec.europa.eu/funding-opportunities/calls-proposals/2022-cef-transport-call_en">the Call</a> page, and the <a href="https://cinea.ec.europa.eu/news-events/events/2022-cef-transport-call-info-day-2022-10-05_en">Info Day page</a> to find the presentations and recording of the info day session. More than 600 FAQs are now available on the <a href="https://ec.europa.eu/info/funding-tenders/opportunities/portal/screen/support/faq;type=0,1;categories=;tenders=;programme=43251567;keyword=;freeTextSearchKeyword=CEF%20Transport;matchWholeText=true;period=null;status=0;sortQuery=relevance;faqListKey=faqSearchTablePageState">FAQ support</a> on the Funding & Tenders portal.</p>
<p>To be admissible your application must contain Part A and the GIS duly completed online, and Part B uploaded on time. As indicated in section 5 of the Call document – also available on the <a href="https://ec.europa.eu/info/funding-tenders/opportunities/portal/screen/how-to-participate/reference-documents">Reference Documents</a> of the portal, <b>the mandatory annexes must also be submitted</b>. These documents concern:</p>
<p>-          Agreement by the concerned Member States benefitting from the project  – for all applications</p>
<p>-          Calculator for ERTMS and RFN applications or detailed budget table per Work Package for other applications</p>
<p>-          Timetable/Gantt chart – for all applications</p>
<p>-          Environmental compliance file including the required declarations for all applications (except ERTMS and RFN applications). Please see the <a href="https://ec.europa.eu/info/funding-tenders/opportunities/portal/screen/support/faq/18080">FAQ 18080</a>. </p>
<p>-          Activity reports of last year and List of previous projects - unless exempted from operational capacity check such as public bodies, member state organisations, international organisations and beneficiaries of grants under CEF1 and CEF2.    </p>
<p>In addition, if the application concerns works: </p>
<p>-          Full cost-benefit analysis (CBA) report and CBA cash flow template - only for works or mixed projects with a budget (eligible costs) above EUR 10 million - <a href="https://ec.europa.eu/info/funding-tenders/opportunities/portal/screen/support/faq/17952">unless exempted</a></p>
<p>-          Simplified CBA calculator – only for works or mixed projects with a budget (eligible costs) below EUR 10 million - <a href="https://ec.europa.eu/info/funding-tenders/opportunities/portal/screen/support/faq/17952">unless exempted</a></p>
<p>We wish you the best of luck in your application!</p>"},{"approvalDate":"2022-12-15","lastChangeDate":"2022-12-15T11:10:07.042","content":"<!--[if gte mso 9]><xml>

title: data - studies, works or mixed
callTitle: CEF 2 Transport - Actions related to smart and interoperable mobility – General envelope
descriptionByte:
Objective:

The general objective is to modernise transport infrastructure on the Core and Comprehensive Networks of the TEN-T.

Scope:
  • In accordance with the Article 9(2)(b)(ii) of the CEF Regulation, studies and / or works, related to the following Projects will be supported:
  • Where complementary and consistent with the activities supported by the Digital Europe Programme regarding Common Data Spaces, projects to support the creation, collection, management, sharing and dissemination of accurate and up-to-date transport, traffic and travel data for all modes. In particular, projects will enable interoperability and ensure the digitisation of the related processes. This inter alia covers projects related to increasing availability of data for transport safety, urban vehicle access regulations, collaborative logistics and multimodal travel with the aim to make them available to relevant public and/or private stakeholders, in particular for mobility and traffic management purposes and the implementation of sustainable urban mobility indicators (SUMI).

Where relevant, the above mentioned projects shall take into account the innovative new technologies and solutions in the fields of smart applications for transport resulting from Horizon Europe activities.

Digital platforms supported under CEF must be accessible for use by all operators on a non-discriminatory basis.

Investments concerning rolling stock, notably the installation of sensors or other devices on wagons, will not be supported.

<p><b>Information update on the 2022 SIMOBGEN call</b></p>
<p>Call published: 13/09/2022</p>
<p>Call deadline: 18/01/2023</p>
<p>Indicative budget: EUR 400 000 000</p>
<p>Total budget requested by the applicants: EUR 1 110 153 879</p>
<p>Number of admissible and eligible proposals: 76</p>
<p>Number of inadmissible proposals: 2</p>
<p>Number of ineligible proposals: 1</p>
<p>Number of successful proposals: 20</p>
<p>Total budget for the successful proposals: EUR 399 671 139</p>
<p> </p>

<p>15/12/2022 11:10</p>
<p>There are few days left to finish your application in response to any of the 9 CEF Transport calls for proposals, closing on 18 January 2023 at 17:00. In total, 41 topics are open for submission on the  <a href="https://ec.europa.eu/info/funding-tenders/opportunities/portal/screen/opportunities/topic-search;callCode=null;freeTextSearchKeyword=CEF-T-2022;matchWholeText=true;typeCodes=1,0;statusCodes=31094502,31094503,31094501;programmePeriod=2021%20-%202027;programCcm2Id=43251567;programDivisionCode=null;focusAreaCode=null;destinationGroup=null;missionGroup=null;geographicalZonesCode=null;programmeDivisionProspect=null;startDateLte=null;startDateGte=null;crossCuttingPriorityCode=null;cpvCode=null;performanceOfDelivery=null;sortQuery=sortStatus;orderBy=asc;onlyTenders=false;topicListKey=topicSearchTablePageState">Funding & Tenders portal</a>.</p>
<p>We strongly advise you not to wait until the last minute to submit your application!</p>
<p>You may also see <a href="https://cinea.ec.europa.eu/funding-opportunities/calls-proposals/2022-cef-transport-call_en">the Call</a> page, and the <a href="https://cinea.ec.europa.eu/news-events/events/2022-cef-transport-call-info-day-2022-10-05_en">Info Day page</a> to find the presentations and recording of the info day session. More than 600 FAQs are now available on the <a href="https://ec.europa.eu/info/funding-tenders/opportunities/portal/screen/support/faq;type=0,1;categories=;tenders=;programme=43251567;keyword=;freeTextSearchKeyword=CEF%20Transport;matchWholeText=true;period=null;status=0;sortQuery=relevance;faqListKey=faqSearchTablePageState">FAQ support</a> on the Funding & Tenders portal.</p>
<p>To be admissible your application must contain Part A and the GIS duly completed online, and Part B uploaded on time. As indicated in section 5 of the Call document – also available on the <a href="https://ec.europa.eu/info/funding-tenders/opportunities/portal/screen/how-to-participate/reference-documents">Reference Documents</a> of the portal, <b>the mandatory annexes must also be submitted</b>. These documents concern:</p>
<p>-          Agreement by the concerned Member States benefitting from the project  – for all applications</p>
<p>-          Calculator for ERTMS and RFN applications or detailed budget table per Work Package for other applications</p>
<p>-          Timetable/Gantt chart – for all applications</p>
<p>-          Environmental compliance file including the required declarations for all applications (except ERTMS and RFN applications). Please see the <a href="https://ec.europa.eu/info/funding-tenders/opportunities/portal/screen/support/faq/18080">FAQ 18080</a>. </p>
<p>-          Activity reports of last year and List of previous projects - unless exempted from operational capacity check such as public bodies, member state organisations, international organisations and beneficiaries of grants under CEF1 and CEF2.    </p>
<p>In addition, if the application concerns works: </p>
<p>-          Full cost-benefit analysis (CBA) report and CBA cash flow template - only for works or mixed projects with a budget (eligible costs) above EUR 10 million - <a href="https://ec.europa.eu/info/funding-tenders/opportunities/portal/screen/support/faq/17952">unless exempted</a></p>
<p>-          Simplified CBA calculator – only for works or mixed projects with a budget (eligible costs) below EUR 10 million - <a href="https://ec.europa.eu/info/funding-tenders/opportunities/portal/screen/support/faq/17952">unless exempted</a></p>

<p>-          Calculator for ERTMS and RFN applications or detailed budget table per Work Package for other applications</p>

<p>-          Environmental compliance file including the required declarations for all applications (except ERTMS and RFN applications). Please see the <a href="https://ec.europa.eu/info/funding-tenders/opportunities/portal/screen/support/faq/18080">FAQ 18080</a>. </p>
<p>-          Activity reports of last year and List of previous projects - unless exempted from operational capacity check such as public bodies, member state organisations, international organisations and beneficiaries of grants under CEF1 and CEF2.    </p>
<p>In addition, if the application concerns works: </p>
<p>-          Full cost-benefit analysis (CBA) report and CBA cash flow template - only for works or mixed projects with a budget (eligible costs) above EUR 10 million - <a href="https://ec.europa.eu/info/funding-tenders/opportunities/portal/screen/support/faq/17952">unless exempted</a></p>
<p>-          Simplified CBA calculator – only for works or mixed projects with a budget (eligible costs) below EUR 10 million - <a href="https://ec.europa.eu/info/funding-tenders/opportunities/portal/screen/support/faq/17952">unless exempted</a></p>

title: EMSWe – studies, works or mixed
callTitle: CEF 2 Transport - Actions related to smart and interoperable mobility – General envelope
descriptionByte:
Objective:

The general objective is to modernise transport infrastructure on the Core and Comprehensive Networks of the TEN-T.

Scope:

In accordance with the Article 9(2)(b)(ii) of the CEF Regulation, the following Projects will be supported:

  • studies and / or works, related to the implementation of the European Maritime Single Window environment (EMSWe) (as defined in the Regulation (EU) 2019/1239 establishing a European Maritime Single Window environment (OJ OJ L 198, 25.7.2019, p. 64)).

Where relevant, the above mentioned projects shall take into account the innovative new technologies and solutions in the fields of smart applications for transport resulting from Horizon Europe activities.

Digital platforms supported under CEF must be accessible for use by all operators on a non-discriminatory basis.
